description: Two unrelated patterns. (1) Ply-3 openings with me second: my stone is not in column 3 or 5 and column 5 is empty (e.g. 3,2,4); strongest firing. (2) Crowded middlegames where the opponent holds row 4 of column 5 (0-indexed) and I hold row 4 of column 4, usually with their stone above or mine below in column 5. Many firings fit neither; possibly a distributed or random direction.
effect: none measurable (steering to zero or to the dev max changes move probabilities by at most 0.05)
notes: Best dev F1 0.480 (P 0.445, R 0.520, AUROC 0.75), simulation share 0.09. Ply-3 rule alone: F1 0.42 (R 0.35). The late-game cell pattern came from firing-vs-non cell counts and fits some minimal pairs (an opponent stone on (4,4) kills it; one on (5,5) boosts it), but the same column-5 pattern on a near-empty board gives a strongly negative activation, so it is a correlate within certain game lines, not a cause. The ply-3 table is asymmetric. Synthesis reached 5.09, below the dev max of 5.663. Likely a mixture or random direction. Audit fix: the two ply-30 synthesis lines (5.09, 5.08) passed through a completed four at move 29 and were replaced by ply-28 lines with no four completed by any move (4.615, 4.601); best valid synthesis is 4.615.
